sloka: अथ शक्तिं समादाय कालरात्रिमिवान्तकः।चिक्षेपानिलपुत्राय त्रिशिरा रावणात्मजः ।। ६.७०.३८ ।।
transliteration: atha śaktiṁ samādāya kālarātrimivāntakaḥ।cikṣepānilaputrāya triśirā rāvaṇātmajaḥ ।। 6.70.38 ।।

translations.english: In the same manner, Trisira, the son of Ravana sprung up and seized a javelin, just as God of death in dark night and hurled at the son of wind god and shattered.
